scope: Five depicted layouts only. No source scripts executed. No core/app/runtime collider edits. No Unity/campaign/save changes.

conversion.units: 1 board unit = 16 source pixels; x=(px-300)/16; y=(300-py)/16
conversion.purpose: Preserve relative centers, radii and polylines of the pictured characters. Not a default-size puzzle study.
conversion.angles: clockwise screen -> counterclockwise world by negation
conversion.thickness: Source body thickness 12px = .75 units; Designer uses its existing .5-unit tube. No collider override.
conversion.pins: Source p1/p2 drawing tabs replaced by existing standard owner-radius-relative pins at source angles, with explicit declared target. Detached links and owner-gap conflicts retained as flagged reference evidence, not repaired or claimed working.
conversion.guides: Source guide position and axis retained; native complete Designer guides baked. Source angle precision retained.
conversion.bombs: Native hosted bombs at source coordinates; drawing armLength/armStart has no equivalent authoring field and is not added as a collider.
conversion.difficulty: Source difficulty tags are unverified and not imported as evidence.
